test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Q is married to P. M is the husband of K. R is the brother of Q. T is the daughter of K. P is the father of M. How is Q related to T?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) Q is married to P. 

2) P is the father of M. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56271edd844afdc70b75e08b2ddc2bba0bf05b2ac8aa4f6ed34219fb518e4ede.png] 

3) R is the brother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/278eb0a52532a04e9664137238d25a993be6b8b1bea67f52bfa1e7cae459f8ec.png] 

4) T is the daughter of K. 

5) M is the husband of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7170b308080b601b82d4fd6af0966739e4a3c04f654f805a3ede3eb1952a2003.png] 

Thus, Q is T's paternal grandmother or father’s mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
